chonk.description: Measures where the room on a drive went, biggest first, and clears out what you no longer want.
chonk.drives.hint: Sizes only, nothing is opened, so this is far quicker than a Purrge scan over the same tree.

chonk.wholefolder: A folder goes whole, with everything inside it. Everything goes to the Recycle Bin, so it can be brought back.
